== Trivia ==
In the Author Fight youn are fighting 5 authos at once. If you bring one of them in there second dace all of them do. 

The Author is a split phase boss, the first phase of the Author is a regular and mostly harmless Trollface sprite, but once hit (a currently unknown number of times), it will turn into a different sprite and grow an upper and lower body.

* When it reaches this phase, it will claim that "It's too late to run home crying" before unleashing a never-ending flurry of bullets upon the user.
** The second phase entity can detect and will aim at you even if you have used potions which should prevent it from being able to do so.
* The Trollface is not considered a boss enemy, and this makes using a specific potion which turns all non boss enemies in the current room into coins a strategy to defeat it. This is reported to not work on the second phase entity.
** Subsequent rooms allegedly contain more Trollfaces. It's currently unknown how far this goes on for.---You can only beat him once each run and then have to go back to spawn ending the run.
